shot_types.label: 面部特写
shot_types.value: tight close-up portrait focusing on facial features and eyes, clean framing with minimal background distraction, high detail skin and expression emphasis

shot_types.label: 胸像构图
shot_types.value: portrait shot framed from chest up, balanced composition highlighting face, shoulders, and neckline, classic studio portrait framing

shot_types.label: 七分身构图
shot_types.value: medium-long shot framed from mid-thigh to head, cinematic cowboy-style framing, strong subject presence with partial environment context

shot_types.label: 全身标准构图
shot_types.value: full body portrait framing from head to toe, balanced proportions, feet fully visible, clean vertical composition suitable for studio outdoor shots

shot_types.label: 环境人像中景
shot_types.value: medium-wide shot placing subject within surrounding environment, subject still dominant while context supports mood and story

shot_types.label: 环境人像大远景
shot_types.value: wide establishing portrait with small subject relative to environment, strong sense of space and atmosphere, controlled composition for scale

shot_types.label: 高角度俯拍
shot_types.value: high-angle shot looking down at the subject, altered perspective emphasizing posture and environment, clean and intentional overhead composition

body_types.label: 纤细 (Slim)
body_types.value: naturally slender and graceful physique, lean but healthy, well-proportioned body, elegant lines, youthful and fit appearance

body_types.label: 丰满 (Plump)
body_types.value: voluptuous body with soft curves and healthy fullness, well-proportioned torso, feminine silhouette without exaggeration

body_types.label: 健壮 (Muscular)
body_types.value: toned yoga body with distinct 11-line abs, fit but slender limbs, taut tummy, healthy skin glow, athletic and energetic appearance

cup_sizes.label: A Cup
cup_sizes.value: Bust volume is small and close to the ribcage profile. Subtle curvature with minimal gravitational sag. Underbust boundary and shadow are faint. In most outfits, the silhouette change is modest.

cup_sizes.label: B Cup
cup_sizes.value: Bust volume is modest and clearly present. Stable contour in neutral posture with light gravitational influence. Underbust boundary is mild; shadow is soft.

cup_sizes.label: C Cup
cup_sizes.value: Bust volume is medium and balanced against the torso. Clear, natural contour with moderate gravitational influence. Underbust boundary becomes visible in many angles.

cup_sizes.label: D Cup
cup_sizes.value: Bust volume is medium-large and distinctly visible relative to the torso. Gravitational load produces a clearer underbust boundary and natural underbust shadow. The silhouette is visibly shaped by volume.

cup_sizes.label: E Cup
cup_sizes.value: Bust volume is large and immediately apparent. Underbust boundary and contact with the torso are more pronounced due to weight and volume. Fabric tension and shape-conforming behavior appear.

cup_sizes.label: F Cup
cup_sizes.value: Bust volume is very large and becomes a major contributor to upper-body silhouette. Gravitational influence is strong, creating a stable and clearly defined underbust boundary.

cup_sizes.label: G Cup
cup_sizes.value: Bust volume is extremely large and dominates the upper-body massing. Weight and volume significantly affect shape; the underbust boundary and natural shadow are consistently visible.
